author: creeperslayer431
body:
I think that at the end of a hard fought game the winning and losing team should be rewarded as like a mini award by Getting xp.

Xp will be multiplied if they are donors. 

Possibly give winning team like - 7 or 6?  x Donor Rank (Only if your a donor you can get more than 6 or 7)
Losing team: 4? x Donor Rank (Same as above^)

Just gives players a award for playing a match even if the match was short it also shows that you care about the players by rewarding them even if they lose. 

Thank You,
- SWAG23JorDan
